candidates.change_summary: Replace the final return true with return false so successful non-reverting calls to transfer return false instead of true.

Change the loop to always skip body by iterating zero times, causing transfer to return true without performing any calls (changes observable return when calls would have succeeded/failured impact), here by setting loop bound to 0.

Remove the check against address(this) in validAddress so the modifier no longer rejects the contract's own address, potentially allowing transfer to behave differently (calls to own contract allowed).
